label: Own being as esse tantum: the nature of x is being itself
definition: `OwnBeingByQuiddity F A x`: the nature of x is the respect esse itself ('cuius quiditas est ipsum suum esse', De ente cap.3; 'esse tantum'). Read with content identity of respects, so a creature whose existence is really identical with its essence (Suárez's account) is not thereby its own being in this sense.
note: Stipulative analyst definition, attribution deferred; navigated from ST I q.4 a.1 ad 3, q.3 a.4 co. and De ente capp.3-4 (Baur/Koch), read in the materialized witnesses (docs/notes/rdep-to-ract.md).
